dct_description_sm: 2 bar scales on map, given in “Miliaria Germanicæ” and “Leucae Hispanicæ.”
Latitudinal and longitudinal lines along margins.
3 ancillary maps: Insula Iamaica; Ins. S. Ioannis; Is. Margareta cum confiniis.
Inset map: Havana: portius celeberimus totius india occidentalis.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 65.
"360" and "361" on verso, and Latin text.
